# SetupExtensions

**Class** · namespace `VRFramework.Core.Editors.Setup` · assembly `VRFramework.Core.Editors` · [view source](https://git.cie-group.cz/vr-framework/vrf4/core/-/blob/main/Editor/Setup/SetupExtension.cs#L53)

## Methods

### CollectSteps() {#collectsteps}

Every extension's steps, in order. An extension that throws while building its list is
reported and skipped rather than taking the project setup down with it - but note that
skipping shortens the sequence, so if it throws only on some of the reloads the setup
causes, the runner will lose its place. Build lists that cannot fail.

```csharp
public static List<SetupStep> CollectSteps()
```
